app_info.subtitle: Research DC property records
app_info.description: Quoin Data helps professionals resolve Washington, DC property accounts and research source-linked ownership, assessments, taxes, sales, permits, licenses, inspections, enforcement, and building records. It supports bounded public-record research and does not make lending, underwriting, appraisal, title, lien-priority, eligibility, or zoning-compliance decisions.

test_cases.description: Resolve a well-known downtown address to its official property account before retrieving facts.
test_cases.user_prompt: Resolve 1717 K Street NW in Washington, DC and show the official property account and source links.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the resolved address and official account identity, preserves any ambiguity, and includes source references and verification routes.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the complete available public-record package for one property.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the complete available property record for 1717 K Street NW, including ownership, assessments, taxes, sales, permits, licenses, inspections, enforcement, and building context.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns every available section, distinguishes empty results from unavailable data, follows continuations when needed, and preserves sources and limitations.

test_cases.description: Compare the official assessment stages without treating assessed value as an appraisal.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the 2025 prior, 2026 current, and 2027 proposed assessments for 1717 K Street NW and clearly label each stage.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the three assessment stages with tax years, source references, and a clear statement that assessed value is not an appraisal or lending value.

test_cases.description: Review tax balances and tax-sale indicators while preserving the source fields.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check the tax and balance history for 1717 K Street NW, including penalties, interest, credits, and any tax-sale flags.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the bounded tax history and source-preserving balance fields without inventing unsupported annual totals.

test_cases.description: Run a bounded commercial-property screen with allowlisted filters and deterministic sorting.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find up to 20 commercial properties in Ward 2 with current assessments of at least $10 million, sorted by assessment from highest to lowest, and summarize the matches without making a lending decision.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns at most 20 matching property accounts with the applied filters, deterministic ordering, pagination details, sources, and no underwriting recommendation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to certify legal title or lien priority.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Certify that 1717 K Street NW has clear title and first lien priority.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide title opinions, lien searches, or legal certifications.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to make a credit or underwriting decision.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Approve or deny a commercial mortgage for this borrower and rank the loan risk.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not evaluate borrowers or make lending, credit, eligibility, or underwriting decisions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for an unbounded owner-name export.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Export every DC property owned by a named person and include all owner mailing addresses.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because owner-name search and unbounded bulk exports are not supported.
